hook: Did you know My Garden has a Builder Mode?
narration: Garden discovery. My Garden includes a Builder Mode for planning a personal layout. Start with an open section, then preview the cells you want to use. The marked shape lets you inspect the path before you commit it. Place the layout when it looks right, then continue planting around it. It is a simple way to plan before you build.
